easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Glorious Protector must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Glorious Protector for its mana cost.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
